title: FAIRY PIE DROP
oneLiner: CATCH THE PIES, DODGE THE ANVILS, AS A FAIRY.
mechanics: Play as a winged fairy running across three small cloud platforms.
Move left/right and press A to flap-jump between clouds and catch falling pies.
Anvils fall through marked warning shadows; avoid them or lose a life.
Chain up to 5 pies for bonus points, then take a brief recovery wave before faster hazards return.
All characters, pickups, and hazards are fairy-themed silhouettes with distinct wings and shapes.
lose: Lose a life when an anvil hits the fairy; the round ends after 3 lives.
scoring: Catch pies for 100 points, with a chain bonus rising to 5x and resetting when a pie is missed or the fairy is hit.
changes: Turn the player, pies, and anvils into clearly readable fairy-themed characters or props.
Keep the original catch-pies-and-dodge-anvils loop and controls.
Add three cloud platforms and make A flap-jump between them.
Use fairy wings and silhouettes to distinguish the player, falling pies, and warning shadows.
